evidence.title: Anthropic gets its first court win over the Pentagon’s supply-chain risk label
Anthropic was illegally blacklisted by the Trump administration, court rules

summary: A federal judge ruled that the Pentagon’s designation of Anthropic as a supply‑chain risk, imposed by the Trump administration, was illegal. The decision clears the AI startup of the blacklist and underscores limits on government authority over tech firms.
title: Federal Court Rules Pentagon’s Supply-Chain Risk Label on Anthropic Unlawful, Overturning Trump Administration Blacklist
